sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS customer_count
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
  AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND t.amount > 4000
